scope: decomposition-oracle Gröbner stage only (matrix-F4 / Boolean F5 criterion / inherited F4); not an end-to-end ECDLP cost
note: every file here except oracle_ladder/K0_15_m3_rejected_*.json was produced by binaries built from exactly this revision (a clean-worktree rebuild of the sources reproduces the ladder word operations to the digit); the evidence directory is committed on top of it
baseline: SolverEngine::MatrixF4 { max_degree: 3 } — the pre-round default — selected on the final binary with KIC_F4_INHERIT=0, so both sides of every comparison are the same build
unit: 64-bit word operations: elimination XORs on both sides; the inherited engine additionally charges one word operation per word read and per word written by specialisation (specialise_word_ops), which the from-scratch build never pays

host.note: shared cloud VM, no CPU pinning; wall time is a practicality note, not the metric

variants.baseline: KIC_F4_INHERIT=0 (MatrixF4, full Macaulay matrix at every node)
variants.f5_criterion: KIC_F4_INHERIT=0 KIC_F4_CRITERION=f5 (MatrixF4 rows filtered by the Boolean F5 criterion; criterion XORs charged)
variants.inherited_f4: the shipped default: InheritedF4 on quadratic systems, MatrixF4 on cubic ones; root RREF below 24 variables, echelon-only at 24+
variants.inherited_f4_forced: KIC_F4_INHERIT=1 (inherit on every degree; differs from the default only on the K_0/2^9 m=3 rung)
variants.holdout_*: --ladder holdout for baseline and the default engine
variants.probes/: inherited_f4_probe with KIC_F4_INHERIT=1: every captured node system reduced from scratch and specialised both ways; decisive rows cross-checked against a from-scratch child reduction (args: a n targets degree m)
variants.oracle_ladder/K0_15_m3_{matrix_f4_refere: ic boundary --oracles on the K_0/2^15 m=3 cell at this revision: the reference, inheriting forced on the cubic system (0.60x), and forced with a fully reduced root (0.67x)
variants.oracle_ladder/K0_15_m3_rejected_*.json: the two rejected rescue policies on the same cell — a drift-triggered basis rebuild (factor 1) and a cost-triggered switch of the subtree to the from-scratch engine (factor 2) — measured on an exploratory build whose policy code was removed before commit 1b409578; retained as the record of what was tried, 0.48x and 0.45x against the reference
